  "overall_experience": "The student found GitLab to be a powerful platform for managing academic code and collaborating on projects, especially valuing the control offered by local deployment. While the breadth of features was a significant advantage, the initial setup and maintenance of a local instance presented a notable challenge. Once configured, its comprehensive functionality made it a valuable tool for their version control and source code management needs, despite a steeper learning curve compared to previous experiences."
